aboutGame.title: What is Farming Camp?
paragraphs: Farming Camp is a cozy single-player farming simulation game. You run a camp farm, grow crops, care for animals, complete daily tasks, and join camp activities while building friendships with the campers around you.

Progression follows a simple daily loop: plant and water, harvest and sell, then reinvest into storage, tools, and new plots. Our guides cover beginner setup, crop and animal management, characters, missions, mini-games, and platform details.

faq.title: Farming Camp FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Farming Camp.

items.question: What is Farming Camp?
items.answer: Farming Camp is a cozy single-player farming simulation game. You run a camp farm, grow crops, raise animals, complete daily tasks, and join camp activities while building friendships with fellow campers.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Farming Camp?
items.answer: Clear your starting plot, plant fast-growing crops, and reinvest your first coins into storage and tools before spending on decorations.

items.question: Which platforms is Farming Camp available on?
items.answer: Farming Camp is available on PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox.

items.question: Does Farming Camp have codes or multiplayer?
items.answer: No. Farming Camp is a single-player game with no redeem codes and no multiplayer modes, so all progress is saved in your own game.

items.question: How do I progress faster in Farming Camp?
items.answer: Keep the daily loop running: water and harvest on time, sell every harvest, finish chores and classes for points, and upgrade storage and tools before cosmetic items.
